_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/triggers/test_turned_face_up.py. t_tfu_snatcher is Kheru Spellsnatcher's 'When this creature is turned face up' on a cheap morph, reduced to a bare draw so the test measures the trigger and not the counterspell. t_tfu_dread is Growing Dread's 'Whenever you turn a permanent face up, put a +1/+1 counter on it'. t_tfu_beast_trail narrows the same trigger with a subtype filter, so a test can show the filter reads the face-up card rather than the 2/2 shell. t_tfu_raptor is Deathmist Raptor's graveyard watcher, reduced to a draw.
